sun_pharma_coverage_closure.root_cause: The claim extractor's declared_claims list only contained the 9 factual claim entries from answer['claims']. It had no knowledge of the 7 validated relationships (REL-001..REL-007). Any economic interpretation prose derived from relationship validation could not match any declared claim → reported as undeclared. All 7 unmatched items were Type B (relationship interpretations) or Type A/C (paraphrase of declared claim or evidence-gap statement). Zero Type E (genuine undeclared material claims) were found.
sun_pharma_coverage_closure.fix_applied: _adapt_composition_answer_for_extractor() now synthesizes relationship entries from answer['relationships'] and adds them to the declared_claims list passed to the extractor. Cache fingerprint updated to schema_version=claim_extraction_v2 and includes declared_ids so the fix forces a fresh extraction. Data-derived coverage upgrade: if undeclared_count=0 and all extracted claims have declared_match, INCOMPLETE is upgraded to COMPLETE (LLM conservatism hedge).
